paragraph.text: Alongside the Lead Front-End role, I've been running a Platform Architect mission at CBA for a few months: the architecture and standards around agentic AI, an internal platform built on

, and training around a hundred people on LLMs. That's where I understood where things really get stuck. The biggest blocker isn't technical, it's the fear of getting lost, of not knowing what to do with it. And most teams use AI to go a bit faster on what they were already doing, without rethinking the way they work. That's what I want to spend my time on: helping people understand what AI is, not just put up with it, and dare to rethink everything instead of just speeding up. I think society will have to restructure itself around what AI can bring us, and I want to help make that happen well, with people and not against them.
